description: We are Analytica UFRJ, and in this year we're competing in the Field Shift challenge! We are bringing our data science proficiency, together with frontier web development knowledge to provide an innovative solution to the farmers challenges. We are interested in AI, web development, data analysis, ML, and much more!
summary: The fieldshift app allows for fast recognition of fields through preset polygons, allowing to gain granular insight about fields and their changes. When a polygon is selected, it provides data about that field, with full reports, a timeline that allows to see changes through time, and an AI assistant that writes information in a more human-readable way, allowing for deeper insights.
details: The fieldshift app uses a full screen map view that allows to select polygons that contain regions with distinct crops, obtained through <>, allowing to see information about that area, see a timeline of crop rotation, see the data info (where it comes from), and get detailed information from climate, water balance, rain, temperature, soil moisture, vegetation, soil data, and its context. It also contains a full field report with more details, including El Niño forecasts, and an AI chat that allows to understand data in a more human-readable manner. It innovates by aggregating information, making it readily available and faster to find about specific fields and how they shift across time.
dataRefs: NASA GIBS WMTS tiles (SMAP L4 surface and root-zone soil moisture, IMERG precipitation, MODIS NDVI, EVI and land surface temperature, GRACE)
NASA POWER daily point API (rain, temperature, solar for the climate and water balance)
projectRefs: USDA NASS Crop Sequence Boundaries 2025 (US polygons)
USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer class table
USDA NASS North Dakota Annual Statistical Bulletin 2025 (planting windows)
USDA NASS Quick Stats (pilot county yields)
FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 (Kc values, ET0 method)
Google Map Tiles API (optional adapter, needs a key)
Meteomatics API (forecasts in the Field Report pipeline)
